BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child care licensing assistance; and adding a new section to chapter 43.216 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 43.216 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: At the request of a prospective licensee considering or in the process of becoming licensed as an agency under this chapter, the department shall:
(1) Meet with the individual to explain the licensure requirements; and
(2) Inspect the physical space that is contemplated for licensure and inform the prospective licensee of:
(a) Any changes needed to the physical space that are required for licensure; and
(b) Any other existing barriers to licensure.
